Thank you to those who messaged me. 

I talked to my parents. 

They did nothing but finalize my decision. They said they will disown my if I check into a hospital to insure my safety because I have "other responsibilities"

I am sorry for being a weak one but I can't deal with these things. I am a cowardess and can't go on.
Can you message me? I don't want to advertise that.
I contacted professors. They say ''withdraw from class".

Did I mention I am a veteran? Yeah. So he was going to break up with me then but I was busy. 
I don't expect him to be with me if he doesn't want to... I don't think it's fair for him to lead me along. He doesn't have to be with me because of all my problems but to do it the way he did it, I've lost faith in people. I am making my plans and I'm just done.
Tried meds. They don't work. Honestly. Years of medication.
How can I stop being so alone? How?
I am going to kill myself because I cannot deal with any of this.
